about_the_game:
Gather CCG is a turn-based online card game where players take on the role of Alchemists, competing to master elemental powers and outsmart their opponents through clever strategy.

Build and customize your deck with units, spells, and weapons powered by the five elemental forces — Fire, Water, Earth, Air, and Darkness.
Each match is a test of your strategy and timing as you summon powerful units, cast devastating spells, and unleash explosive elemental combos that can turn the tide of battle.

Climb through the ranked ladder, collect new cards, and expand your collection to strengthen your deck.
Refine your playstyle and rise to become the ultimate Alchemist.

Whether you enjoy tactical battles or creative deck-building, Gather CCG offers a vibrant and competitive online experience that rewards both strategy and imagination.

🧪 Key Features

  • Strategic Turn-Based Card Battles – Plan each move carefully and anticipate your opponent’s tactics.

  • Flexible Deck Building System – Combine cards from different elements to create powerful synergies and combos.

  • Ranked Mode – Compete with players worldwide and climb the seasonal rankings.

  • Over 100 Collectible Cards – Master the elemental powers of Fire, Water, Earth, Air, and Darkness.
